data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mah means 'ocean' or 'abundance'. In Islamic tradition, it is associated with Allah's infinite mercy and blessings. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mah usually hope their child will grow to embody ocean, abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
